name: DataOps Guardian
description: Persists incident workflow state and enforces DataOps investigation policy.

enforceRequireToolsOnAgentRuns.description: Legacy compatibility switch. true maps to requireToolsGateMode=all_agent_runs.

requireToolsGateMode.description: Control require_tools enforcement. disabled is intended for controlled A/B evaluation; durable incident and approval policy remains active.

kubernetes.description: Administrator-only Kubernetes Deployment rollback configuration. Never model- or caller-supplied.

clusterId.description: Identifier that must match the scoped kubeconfig's current-context name.

kubeconfigPath.description: Absolute path to the disposable, namespace-scoped kubeconfig used for rollback.

allowlist.description: Exact namespace/deployment pairs guardian_rollback_deployment is permitted to mutate.
